name: gw2-leggy
description: GW2 Leggy — Guild Wars 2 legendary tracker Android app

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
